 ‘GTA 6’ Game Length and Mission Count Officially Revealed
 Men's Journal Follow Brandon Key Sun, November 15, 2026 at 4:44 PM UTC Add to Preferred Sources Sun, November 15, 2026 at 4:44 PM UTC ‘GTA 6’ Game Length and Mission Count Officially Revealed It's hard to believe, but Grand Theft Auto 6 will finally be released later this week. Ahead of its November 19 launch, some reviewers have already played the game, and little nuggets of information are slowly trickling out about the game's score and length.
 Reported by Insider Gaming , which states that they have been in contact with some people who have played GTA 6 , it is estimated that GTA 6 will take an estimated 50 hours to complete the main campaign. That number does not include any side activities. If accurate, that would make GTA 6 the longest main story Rockstar Games has ever made.
 Additionally, it has been reported that there are nearly 100 main missions in the game divided across five chapters. That structure is somewhat similar to what was present in Red Dead Redemption 2 . 
 Advertisement Advertisement In an interview with The New York Times (according to Insider Gaming ), Rob Nelson, head of development and co-studio head at Rockstar Games, stated, "I hope that there will be people who want to get up, have a cup of coffee, shower, get dressed, go out for a little exercise," Nelson said.
 His 80-hour playthrough of the game in February included the main story and some optional goals with narrative ramifications. Routines can escalate quickly. "Interact with some people, explore, maybe get into some trouble," he added. "Rob some places, make some money," reads Insider Gaming 's description of the interview.
 A big question for open-world games for a lot of fans is: how long will it take to 100 percent the game? Seemingly, it may take close to 200 hours, as some of the requirements for all the achievements have some randomness to them, like how there are 170 different species of animals in GTA 6 and all of them must be scanned for completion.
 While mileage will vary for different types of fans, the journey through Leonida is sure to be a long one when Grand Theft Auto 6 releases on Thursday, November 19, 2026, for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S.
